content: We have extracted the data from the voting advice application Smartvote. On that platform, candidates respond to questions mainly in categorical form (yes / rather yes / rather no / no). They can also submit a free-text comment in order to justify, explain or differentiate their categorical answer. An example is given in Figure FIGREF1.
